That is direct evidence of strengthening an oversight channel that could constrain politicians, including himself.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.2","4B.3"]},{"title":"Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"June 7, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/actions/202406/07cyber.html","summary":"Kishida convened a 17-expert panel and asked it to shape active cyber-defense bills. This is institution-building with outside expertise, but it is mixed because it strengthens state capacity more than independent constraint.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.2"]},{"title":"Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"August 14, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202408/14kaiken.html","summary":"Kishida said the LDP presidential race should be transparent, with free and vigorous debate, and that he would step aside and support the winner chosen by vote.
